name: Davis Senior High CTE Pathways
what_you_do: School classes in career pathways inside seven industry sectors, taught in a sequence of courses. The district also offers student internships through its CTE program.
who_can_apply: DJUSD high school students. The page does not list which schools offer which pathway. Ask your counselor.
pay_detail: School classes, no pay. Course credit.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Enroll through your counselor during normal course selection.
how_to_apply: Contact your school counselor to enroll in a CTE course. Internships are on the Student Internships tab (see the Internship and Career Development Course).
notes: Page does not say which schools offer which pathways, or give grade or age rules. DJUSD office: (530) 757-5300. Related: the Internship and Career Development Course and the Summer Apprenticeship.
